concept: Organizations: consolidated billing — one bill, volume discounts, RI/SP sharing
tests: Which feature provides a single bill across many accounts, volume discounts and shared RI and Savings Plans benefits.
expected: AWS Organizations with consolidated billing — aggregated usage, volume tiering, RI/Savings Plans sharing across accounts. Triggers: "many accounts", "single consolidated bill", "volume pricing", "shared RI and Savings Plan benefits".
why_not: Separate billing loses aggregation and sharing; Cost Explorer only reports; tags merely categorize spend.
